title: Provide precise source locations and targets in report finding clusters
description: Replace opaque Cluster hash with source location, line numbers, and target IDs in DocumentationReport, CorrectnessReport, and ArchitectureReport markdown renderings.

title: Evaluate correctness and documentation review models against updated prompt rubrics
description: Run argus evaluate correctness and argus evaluate documentation with active model provider profiles to measure precision, recall, and stability on the newly instructed gap, stub, and TODO enforcement rules, tuning adjudication thresholds accordingly.

title: Add seeded documentation corpus cases for gaps/stubs missing TODO comments
description: Expand docs/evaluation/documentation-corpus-v1.json and its workspace to include targets where gaps, inconsistencies, stubs, or unimplemented aspects are documented without TODO markers, verifying that documentation analysis flags them as defects.

title: Add seeded correctness corpus cases for documented stubs and scope gaps
description: Expand docs/evaluation/correctness-corpus-v1.json and its workspace to include targets with documented stubs (e.g., todo!(), unimplemented!(), dummy returns) and scope-implied gaps, verifying that evaluation harnesses detect and surface them as candidate findings even when documented.

title: Update evaluation and policy documentation for correctness gaps and documentation TODO rules
description: Update docs/correctness-evaluation.md, docs/documentation-evaluation.md, and relevant architecture docs to document the rubric rules covering gaps, stubs, documented defect non-exemption, and the TODO requirement in comments.

title: Support surfacing documented gap findings into backlog and top-level documentation
description: Implement workflow / CLI support to export or convert surfaced candidate findings representing documented future work, stubs, and scope gaps directly into project backlog tasks or top-level documentation tracking.
